problems.text: log inverse: f(x) = 10^(x + 3); options a: log_10(x + 3) | b: log_10(x) - 3 | c: log_10(x) + 3 | d: log_10(x - 3)
problems.explain: Write y = 10ˣ⁺³ and swap x and y: x = 10ʸ⁺³. The log undoes the power, y + 3 = log x, and then y = log x − 3. (The 3 is inside the power, so it is undone after the log, outside it: log(x − 3) puts it back inside.) So f⁻¹(x) = log x − 3.

problems.explain: Write y = 10ˣ + 5 and swap x and y: x = 10ʸ + 5. Take 5 away first, 10ʸ = x − 5, then the power: y = log(x − 5). (Taking the log first, log x − 5, undoes the steps in the wrong order.) So f⁻¹(x) = log(x − 5).
